headline: Gameplay Programmer
intro: I build modular, reusable gameplay systems — AI, pathfinding, tools, and UI frameworks — that stay flexible as a game grows. Here are the projects where the programming did the heavy lifting.

bullets: Wrote a custom A* pathfinder that worked on isometric grids
Built enemies that adapt in real time to traps and walls the player places
Created a map generator enabling 6 evolving map designs and 14+ traps
Programmed puzzle mechanics integrated directly into a 3D world
Wired UI and the 3D menu scene into a single interactive space
Engineered a modular first-person gun system supporting multiple weapon types
Built a spawner that places items correctly on top of terrain geometry
Implemented the UI and leaderboard system
Built in-house dialogue, quest, and manual systems within a one-week jam
Authored a toon shader with an outline pass
